messages.text: I approve the council Raid. Both supporting components have been stated explicitly: Relief using the lodged Grey Petrel and a separate Warrant using offered Vigil. This is my advisory approval under Interim; the Ascendant supplies the operative authority.

reason: The operation preserves our contract and maintains military strength without exposing Lantern to a mixed passage. Its civilian costs remain serious, but the identified relief offsets them on the disclosed accounting. I accept this particular arrangement because assets and orders now match. Approval does not concede military autonomy or a continuing Guild service obligation, and I will evaluate the actual route condition before agreeing next month's commitments.
